ISL 2026-27: FC Goa looks for joy against SC Delhi after heartbreak in AFC Challenge League
 FC Goa returns to the Indian Super League after its continental duties wherein it was knocked out of the AFC Challenge League after two losses in the group stage.
 Updated : Oct 27, 2026 19:14 IST , Margao - 2 MINS READ

 FC Goa’s striker Christian ‘Chiki’ Borrego will look to continue his goalscoring streak for the club, having scored four goals in as many matches so far.

 FC Goa’s striker Christian ‘Chiki’ Borrego will look to continue his goalscoring streak for the club, having scored four goals in as many matches so far.
 | Photo Credit: FC Goa Media
 FC Goa returns to Indian Super League (ISL) 2026-27 action on Wednesday as it hosts Sporting Club Delhi, which is searching for its first points after two consecutive defeats.
 The Gaurs have played once in the league so far, drawing 1-1 with Chennaiyin FC, and will be eager to rediscover their rhythm after a spell away from domestic action that ended in an exit from the AFC Challenge League.
 Head coach Gouramangi Singh stressed the importance of returning with a win, insisting his side must show the same intensity, commitment and concentration they expect of themselves.
 “Every game is important. Our game against Delhi is particularly important for us. Since we are back now (from Asian competition), we want to start with a win,” he said.
 Forward Christian ‘Chiki’ Borrego has been in good scoring form, with four goals in his last four matches across competitions. However, the attacker is focused on the team’s results rather than his individual tally. “I prefer scoring goals to getting wins,” he said.
 ALSO READ: FC Goa exits AFC Challenge League after loss to Kuwait’s Qadsia 
 Sporting Club Delhi, however, will be no pushover.
 Its opening two matches have followed a similar pattern: it led Bengaluru FC 2-1 at half-time before losing 2-3, then took a 1-0 lead against Mohun Bagan Super Giant before suffering a 1-2 defeat.
 Despite the unfavourable results, head coach Tomasz Tchórz remains confident in his side’s performances.
 “I am very happy with the performance of the team. I think we played a very good game. We repeated what was a very good first half performance in Bengaluru. We were dangerous, created a lot of chances against a strong opponent but unfortunately we couldn’t score more goals,” he said.
 The fixture also marks a return to familiar surroundings for SCD defender Sanatomba Singh Yanglem, who previously represented FC Goa. The Gaurs won the last meeting between the two sided 1-0 in February, with Dejan Dražić scoring the winner.
 The game kicks off at 7:30 PM IST.
